# Delete each request and create a new one with corrected amount ($15 less)
for req in yesterday_evening_requests:
    # Delete the original request
    delete_resp = venmo.delete_payment_request(payment_request_id=req['payment_request_id'], access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Deleted request {req['payment_request_id']}: {delete_resp}")
    
    # Create new request with amount reduced by $15
    new_amount = req['amount'] - 15
    create_resp = venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=req['receiver']['email'],
        amount=new_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=req['description'],
        private=req['private']
    )
    print(f"Created new request for {req['receiver']['email']} amount {new_amount}: {create_resp}")
